classification.difficultyReason: Read stage durations and calculate speed, then convert the continuation's speed and duration into distance and add both time and distance to the existing endpoint.

content.prompt: The graph shows the first two stages of a car journey from home to a holiday house.

spec.description: Square journey grid, with Stage A rising to (1.5,150), Stage B horizontal to (2,150), and unused grid for part c.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied stages are visible; the continuation requested in part c is absent.

children.label: a
children.prompt: At what speed, in kilometres per hour, did the car travel during stage A of the journey?

children.label: b
children.prompt: For how long did the car stop during stage B of the journey?

answer.worked:
The horizontal segment runs from $1.5$ h to $2$ h.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Stop duration}&=2-1.5\\\text{Stop duration}&=0.5\text{ h}=30\text{ min}\end{align*}$$

children.label: c
children.prompt:
After stage B, the car continues to travel towards the holiday house at a constant speed of 50 km/h for 2 hours.
Graph this part of the journey on the grid.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\text{Further distance}&=50\times2=100\text{ km}\\\text{Final distance from home}&=150+100=250\text{ km}\\\text{Final time}&=2+2=4\text{ h}\end{align*}$$
Draw a straight line from $(2,150)$ to $(4,250)$.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 2 supplied graph and part c
spec.description: Complete supplied journey graph with the requested continuation from (2,150) to (4,250).
spec.answerVisibility: The blue continuation appears only in the solution.
